bounded_host_request.command:
set -euo pipefail
cd "$HOME/Project/Gserver/projects/TGtumbler/GateApp-Bot"
set +e
docker exec deploy-gaybbs-1 node --import /app/preload/telegram-ipv4-preload.mjs /app/backfillExistingRecruitmentCards.mjs --dry-run
rc=$?
set -e
printf 'DRY_RUN_EXIT=%s\n' "$rc"
docker exec -i deploy-postgres-1 psql -X -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -U gace -d gaybbs -At <<'SQL'
BEGIN READ ONLY;
SELECT json_build_object('state',status,'version',COALESCE(conditions->>'recruitmentUiVersion','legacy'),'count',count(*)) FROM announcement_posts WHERE kind='recruitment' AND room_id IS NULL AND status IN ('published','publishing','sync_error') GROUP BY status,COALESCE(conditions->>'recruitmentUiVersion','legacy') ORDER BY 1::text;
COMMIT;
SQL
